description: Prompt-injection pre-check for text your agent is about to read (tool output, web page, email, document, token names/metadata). Deterministic rules, no LLM: instruction override (EN/DE/FR/ES/IT/PT/PL/RU), role hijack, jailbreaks, system-prompt extraction, fake chat delimiters, text addressed to the AI, concealment, data exfiltration (markdown-image beacons, secrets to URLs), tool/fund hijack (shell pipes, transfers, unlimited approvals, skip-confirmation), crypto lures (seed-phrase requests, claim/airdrop links), hidden text (zero-width, Unicode tag and variation-selector smuggling, bidi, homoglyphs, CSS-hidden HTML, ANSI) and encoded payloads (base64/hex/percent decoded and re-scanned). Returns verdict safe/suspicious/malicious, action allow/treat_as_untrusted_data/block, 0-100 score, findings with character spans, risky links, decoded payloads and a sanitized copy. Batch up to 100 texts per call. Costs $0.002 USDC per call via x402 (charged only on success). Without an x402 wallet you get the payment terms and the paid HTTP URL instead.

items.description: Batch: up to 100 texts (e.g. token names, search results, emails), 200000 characters in total, one price.

source.description: Where the text comes from; tunes a few rules (token_metadata flags any URL in a token name).
